messages:
kai: morning! i'm on my first-week checklist and hit a snag. i can view the infra dashboards in Grafana but the Edit button is disabled. also when i open Sentry for infra-service i get a 404 / 'Project not found'. who should i tag to get both view->edit and project access?

rachel: welcome @kai :wave: for Grafana edits we use the access portal (see bot). if you need folder-level edit ask for 'platform-dashboards editor' + team tag. for Sentry, @elena usually does invites. did you sign in via SSO or a separate account?

elena: hi @kai  i can add you to the Sentry project. send me the email you used to sign in (SSO email preferred) and i'll invite you. if you see 404 it's usually because you're in a different org or the project slug is slightly different (try searching for "infra-service" in the org projects list).

kai: thanks @elena, sending DM with kai@redwood.dev. i did SSO. curious: is there any link between Grafana folder permissions and Sentry access? trying to figure out if there's one person/team to talk to for both.

rachel: they're separate systems and permissions are managed by different teams. devex handles Grafana roles (via the access portal), SRE/product teams own Sentry invites for service projects. it helps to include the reason in the request like "onboarding: need edit to modify CPU alert thresholds".

devex-bot: To request Grafana edit role: https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests -> select "Grafana Editor" -> add team tag (eng-infra) -> include justification. If you need edits faster react with :rocket: or ping #eng-oncall. Approval typically 1-2 business days.

eng-oncall: @kai if this is causing noisy production alerts, include "prod-impact" in the access request and CC @eng-oncall so we can temporarily mute rules. Once you have edit rights ping here with the dashboard link and we'll do a quick review.

kai: requested Grafana edit (included prod-impact) and DM'ed @elena for Sentry invite. i'll paste dashboard link here after edits. thanks for the pointers! :thumbsup:

rachel: great. one more tip: when changing alert thresholds, add a one-line entry to the alert-change log (link in onboarding doc) and mention the incident window to avoid surprises. welcome aboard!

kai: will do 44d thanks everyone!
